description:
Certified Salesforce Developer – On behalf of our client Procom Services is searching for a Salesforce Developer for a permanent position in Raleigh, NC. 
 

 In this role as a Salesforce Developer you will be responsible for implementing, integrating, configuring Salesforce for customers/clients. This role is an active participant in the requirements gathering, planning, implementation and evaluation phases of a variety of Salesforce projects. All applicants should have strong communication skills, be comfortable in front of a customer, and be open to up to 10-15% travel in this role. Salesforce.com Developer Certification or greater is required.
 


 Certified Salesforce Developer Mandatory skills
 2 – 5 Years of experience as a Certified Salesforce Developer with experience configuring, implementing and integrating Salesforce.
 Experience with requirements gathering, preferably with external customers, but not required.
 Salesforce Developer Certification Required.
 General Business Knowledge across multiple industries is preferred, but not required.
 

  

 
 Start Date 
 ASAP 

 
 
 Assignment Length 

 Permanent
